a.lede: Microsoft says China-aligned Storm-0940 used the ARTEX AI agent framework in the ConnectWise Cloud Backup supply chain attack.
a.title: China-aligned hackers deploy AI agents in massive ConnectWise supply chain attack

b.lede: Microsoft points the blame for ConnectWise's breach at a China-aligned hacker, which relied on AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of its customers.
b.title: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
